program.description: Path to the program to debug or attach to

env.description: Additional environment variables, each in the form "KEY=VALUE"

disableASLR.description: Disable address space layout randomization of the debuggee

disableSTDIO.description: Do not create stdin, stdout and stderr for the debuggee

shellExpandArguments.description: Expand program arguments as a shell would

detachOnError.description: Detach from the debuggee if an error occurs while launching

runInTerminal.description: Launch the program inside an integrated terminal

debuggerRoot.description: Working directory of the debugger, used to resolve relative paths

sourcePath.description: Path to the root of the source tree, used to resolve relative source paths

sourceMap.description: Source path remappings, each a [build path, local path] pair

initCommands.description: LLDB commands executed upon debugger startup

preRunCommands.description: LLDB commands executed just before the program is launched or attached to

launchCommands.description: LLDB commands that launch the program, replacing the default launch

attachCommands.description: LLDB commands that attach to the program, replacing the default attach

stopCommands.description: LLDB commands executed each time the program stops

exitCommands.description: LLDB commands executed when the program exits

terminateCommands.description: LLDB commands executed when the debug session ends

waitFor.description: Wait for the process to launch before attaching

coreFile.description: Path to a core file to load instead of attaching to a live process
